answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the terrace until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the fable of the next round. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. What survives to the glacier is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
